31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
32	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
33	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
34	
35	/-- The finite dominant map to `P¹` used by both the divisor representer and the Picard
36	coverage parameter. -/
37	noncomputable def divRepAffP1Map : C.left ⟶ P1 k :=
38	  (exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (C := C)).choose
39	
40	noncomputable instance divRepAffP1Map_isFinite : IsFinite (divRepAffP1Map C) :=
41	  (exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (C := C)).choose_spec.1
42	
43	noncomputable instance divRepAffP1Map_isDominant : IsDominant (divRepAffP1Map C) :=
44	  (exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (C := C)).choose_spec.2.1
45	
46	/-- The chosen map is a morphism over the base field. -/
47	theorem divRepAffP1Map_comp :
48	    divRepAffP1Map C ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom :=
49	  (exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (C := C)).choose_spec.2.2
50	
51	/-- The unconditional Picard coverage parameter attached to the same map used by the
52	divisor representer. -/
53	noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleParameter : ℕ := by
54	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
55	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
56	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
57	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
58	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
59	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
60	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
61	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
62	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
63	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
64	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
65	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
66	  exact admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C)
67	
68	/-- The curve genus is at most the unconditional admissible coverage parameter. -/
69	theorem genus_le_divRepAffAdmissibleParameter :
70	    genus C ≤ divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C := by
71	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
72	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
73	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
74	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
75	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
76	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
77	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
78	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
79	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
80	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
81	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
82	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
83	  change genus C ≤
84	    admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C)
85	  by_cases hg : genus C = 0
86	  · omega
87	  · exact Nat.le_of_lt
88	      (genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero
89	        (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C) hg (chi_moduleKSheaf C))
90	
91	/-- A representer for the widened divisor functor at the genus of a challenge curve.  The finite
92	dominant map to `P1`, the cohomology finiteness instances, and the Euler-characteristic identities
93	are all chosen internally from the curve assumptions. -/
94	noncomputable def divFunctorAffGenusRepresenter :
95	    Σ D : Over (Spec (.of k)), (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy D := by
96	  classical
97	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
98	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
99	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
100	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
101	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
102	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
103	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
104	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
105	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
106	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
107	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
108	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
109	  have hpi : divRepAffP1Map C ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (.of k) :=
110	    divRepAffP1Map_comp C
111	  let D := divRepAffScheme_at (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
112	    (hpi := hpi) (g := genus C) (hO := h0_moduleKSheaf C)
113	    (gamma := genus C) (hgamma := Nat.le_refl _) (hchiGamma := chi_moduleKSheaf C)
114	  exact ⟨D, divFunctorAff_representableBy_at
115	    (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (hpi := hpi)
116	    (g := genus C) (hO := h0_moduleKSheaf C)
117	    (gamma := genus C) (hgamma := Nat.le_refl _) (hchiGamma := chi_moduleKSheaf C)⟩
118	
119	/-- A chosen scheme representing the widened divisor functor at the curve's genus. -/
120	noncomputable def divRepAffGenusScheme : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
121	  (divFunctorAffGenusRepresenter C).1
122	
123	/-- The widened divisor functor at the genus of a challenge curve is representable, with no
124	additional hypotheses. -/
125	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy :
126	    (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
127	  (divFunctorAffGenusRepresenter C).2
128	
129	/-- A representer for the widened divisor functor at the unconditional Picard coverage
130	parameter. The curve genus controls Euler-characteristic normalization independently of the
131	larger divisor degree. -/
132	noncomputable def divFunctorAffAdmissibleRepresenter :
133	    Σ D : Over (Spec (.of k)),
134	      (divFunctorAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)).RepresentableBy D := by
135	  classical
136	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
137	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
138	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
139	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
140	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
141	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
142	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
143	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
144	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
145	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
146	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
147	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
148	  have hpi : divRepAffP1Map C ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (.of k) :=
149	    divRepAffP1Map_comp C
150	  let D := divRepAffScheme_at (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)
151	    (hpi := hpi) (g := divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (hO := h0_moduleKSheaf C)
152	    (gamma := genus C) (hgamma := genus_le_divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
153	    (hchiGamma := chi_moduleKSheaf C)
154	  exact ⟨D, divFunctorAff_representableBy_at
155	    (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (hpi := hpi)
156	    (g := divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (hO := h0_moduleKSheaf C)
157	    (gamma := genus C) (hgamma := genus_le_divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
158	    (hchiGamma := chi_moduleKSheaf C)⟩
159	
160	/-- The chosen scheme representing the widened divisor functor at the unconditional Picard
161	coverage parameter. -/
162	noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleScheme : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
163	  (divFunctorAffAdmissibleRepresenter C).1
164	
165	/-- The widened divisor functor at the unconditional Picard coverage parameter is representable
166	without any additional curve, divisor-degree, or rational-point hypothesis. -/
167	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy :
168	    (divFunctorAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)).RepresentableBy
169	      (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :=
170	  (divFunctorAffAdmissibleRepresenter C).2
171	
172	end Curve
173	
174	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# Functoriality of the WIDENED vehicle along an arbitrary test morphism (R2, residue (b))
10	
11	The widened vehicle `divFamZarAff` (`…AffVehicle.lean`) is functorial along an **arbitrary**
12	morphism `f : T' ⟶ T` of test objects: the value of the restricted family at an affine open
13	`W ⊆ T'.left` — whose `f`-image need not lie in any affine open of `T.left` — is *glued* over a
14	finite basic-open refinement of `W` subordinate to the preimages of affine opens, using the
15	widened S5b Zariski keystones through the basic-open toolkit (`…AffMapKit.lean`).
16	
17	This is the last packaging layer of R2 residue (b): with it the widened carrier of protection
18	I-0492 is a functor on the whole slice over `Spec k`, which is the generality every DD-R
19	consumer (`DivRepGlobalData.pull_comp`) is stated at.
20	
21	## Main declarations
22	
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff.IsPullbackValue` — the characterizing property of the glued
24	  value, with `pullbackValue_unique` (Zariski separation) and `exists_isPullbackValue`
25	  (Zariski gluing).
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff.map C n f : divFamZarAff C n T → divFamZarAff C n T'`, with
27	  `map_id`, `map_comp`, and the no-gluing evaluation `mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom`.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality` — over affine tests, `map` along
29	  `Spec` of an algebra map is `DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom` of that map under the widened affine
30	  collapse.
31	
32	## What is and is not asserted
33	
34	Everything here is about the Zariski topology of the **base**.  R2 widened the curve side, so
35	these are the chart-typed proofs of `DivisorFamilyZarMap.lean` with `DivFamZar` replaced by
36	`DivFamZarAff` — no new geometry, and in particular **no `|P¹(k)|` hypothesis** anywhere in the
37	statements or their route.  What the widened lane still owes is unchanged by this file: the
38	subordinate Stacks 0B8B input (residue (a), out of scope per I-0492 clause 2).
39	-/
40	
41	set_option autoImplicit false
42	/- Statements mix the section rings `Γ(T.left, ·)` with the widened locally certified divisor
43	values over them, which are stated on the product spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see
44	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
45	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
46	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
47	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
48	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
49	
50	universe u
51	
52	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace
53	
54	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
55	
56	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
57	
58	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsProper C.hom] {n : ℕ}
59	
60	namespace divFamZarAff
61	
62	variable {T T' T'' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
63	
64	/-! ## The characterizing property of the glued value -/
65	
66	variable (C n) in
67	/-- The characterizing property of the value at `W` of the restriction of `s` along `f`: on
68	every affine sub-open of `W` contained in the preimage of an affine open `V` of the target, it
69	restricts to the base change of the value of `s` at `V`. -/
70	def IsPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens)
71	    (v : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n) : Prop :=
72	  ∀ (W₀ : T'.left.affineOpens) (hW₀ : W₀.1 ≤ W.1) (V : T.left.affineOpens)
73	    (hV : W₀.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1),
74	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) v
75	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W₀.1 hV) (s.1 V)
76	
77	/-- Values with the pullback property are unique — from the Zariski separation of
78	`DivFamZarAff` over a basic refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens. -/
79	theorem pullbackValue_unique {f : T' ⟶ T} {s : divFamZarAff C n T}
80	    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {v v' : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n}
81	    (hv : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v) (hv' : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v') :
82	    v = v' := by
83	  classical
84	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
85	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
86	    (fun w _ => by
87	      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
88	        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
89	      exact ⟨f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V, hfwV, ⟨⟨V, hVaff⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
90	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W sub hspan (fun r hr => ?_)
91	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
92	  rw [hv ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle,
93	    hv' ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen r⟩ (T'.left.basicOpen_le r) V hle]
94	
95	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
96	-- The instance towers over the section rings of the basic refinement exceed the default
97	-- elaboration budget (as in the chart-typed `divFamZar.exists_isPullbackValue`).
98	/-- **Existence of the glued value**: the restriction of a compatible family of widened classes
99	along an arbitrary morphism of test objects has a value at every affine open of the source,
100	glued over a finite basic-open refinement subordinate to the preimages of affine opens — the
101	widened S5b gluing keystone through `divFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_basic_compat`. -/
102	theorem exists_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
103	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃ v, IsPullbackValue C n f s W v := by
104	  classical
105	  -- the basic refinement subordinate to preimages of affine opens
106	  obtain ⟨sub, hspan, hsub⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W.2
107	    (fun U₀ => ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens, U₀ = f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
108	    (fun w _ => by
109	      obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hfwV, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
110	        T.left.isBasis_affineOpens (show f.left.base w ∈ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) from trivial)
111	      exact ⟨f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V, hfwV, ⟨⟨V, hVaff⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
112	  have hsub' : ∀ r ∈ sub, ∃ V : T.left.affineOpens,
113	      T'.left.basicOpen r ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun r hr => by
114	    obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨V, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hsub r hr
115	    exact ⟨V, hle⟩
116	  choose Vc hVc using hsub'
117	  have hbmul : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
118	      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
119	        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
120	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
121	    exact inf_le_left
122	  have hbmul' : ∀ r r' : ↥sub,
123	      T'.left.basicOpen ((r : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) * (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)))
124	        ≤ T'.left.basicOpen (r' : Γ(T'.left, W.1)) := fun r r' => by
125	    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
126	    exact inf_le_right
127	  -- glue the local base changes over the basic refinement
128	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_glue_of_basic_compat W sub hspan
129	    (fun r : ↥sub => DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
130	      (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r.1 r.2).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r.1) (hVc r.1 r.2))
131	      (s.1 (Vc r.1 r.2)))
132	    hbmul hbmul'
133	    (fun r r' => by
134	      -- the overlap compatibility, from choice independence
135	      rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp,
136	        Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
137	      exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W.2.basicOpen (r.1 * r'.1)⟩) _ _)
138	  -- the glued value has the pullback property
139	  refine ⟨z, fun W₀ hW₀ V hV => ?_⟩
140	  obtain ⟨sub₀, hspan₀, hsub₀⟩ := Scheme.exists_basic_subcover W₀.2
141	    (fun U₀ => ∃ r ∈ sub, U₀ = T'.left.basicOpen r)
142	    (fun w hw => by
143	      have hwW : w ∈ (⨆ r ∈ (↑sub : Set Γ(T'.left, W.1)), T'.left.basicOpen r) := by
144	        rw [iSup_basicOpen_of_span_eq_top _ _ hspan]
145	        exact hW₀ hw
146	      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hwW
147	      obtain ⟨hrsub, hwr⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hr
148	      exact ⟨T'.left.basicOpen r, hwr, ⟨r, hrsub, rfl⟩⟩)
149	  refine eq_of_basic_eq W₀ sub₀ hspan₀ (fun q hq => ?_)
150	  obtain ⟨U₀, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, hqle⟩ := hsub₀ q hq
151	  -- the left side restricts through the glued datum
152	  have hzr : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
153	        (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) z
154	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
155	          (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r hr).1 (T'.left.basicOpen r) (hVc r hr))
156	          (s.1 (Vc r hr)) := hz ⟨r, hr⟩
157	  have hL : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' (T'.left.basicOpen_le q))
158	      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T' hW₀) z)
159	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f (Vc r hr).1 (T'.left.basicOpen q)
160	          (hqle.trans (hVc r hr))) (s.1 (Vc r hr)) := by
161	    rw [← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp,
162	      show ((T'.left.basicOpen_le q).trans hW₀ :
163	          T'.left.basicOpen q ≤ W.1)
164	        = (hqle.trans (T'.left.basicOpen_le r)) from rfl,
165	      ← Over.resAlgHom_comp T' hqle (T'.left.basicOpen_le r),
166	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, hzr, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp,
167	      Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
168	  -- the right side restricts directly
169	  rw [hL, ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, Over.resAlgHom_comp_appLEAlgHom]
170	  exact mapAlgHom_appLE_eq C n f s (W₀ := ⟨_, W₀.2.basicOpen q⟩) _ _
171	
172	/-- Existence and uniqueness of the glued value. -/
173	theorem existsUnique_isPullbackValue (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
174	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : ∃! v, IsPullbackValue C n f s W v := by
175	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isPullbackValue f s W
176	  exact ⟨v, hv, fun v' hv' => pullbackValue_unique hv' hv⟩
177	
178	/-! ## The functoriality -/
179	
180	variable (C n)
181	
182	/-- The value of the restricted widened family at an affine open of the source. -/
183	noncomputable def mapVal (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
184	    (W : T'.left.affineOpens) : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n :=
185	  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose
186	
187	lemma mapVal_spec (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (W : T'.left.affineOpens) :
188	    IsPullbackValue C n f s W (mapVal C n f s W) :=
189	  (existsUnique_isPullbackValue f s W).choose_spec.1
190	
191	lemma mapVal_eq_of (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T) {W : T'.left.affineOpens}
192	    {v : DivFamZarAff C Γ(T'.left, W.1) n} (hv : IsPullbackValue C n f s W v) :
193	    mapVal C n f s W = v :=
194	  pullbackValue_unique (mapVal_spec C n f s W) hv
195	
196	/-- The value of the restricted widened family on an affine open lying in the preimage of an
197	affine open is the plain base change — no gluing. -/
198	lemma mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom (f : T' ⟶ T) (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
199	    {W : T'.left.affineOpens} {V : T.left.affineOpens} (hV : W.1 ≤ f.left ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
200	    mapVal C n f s W
201	      = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (Over.appLEAlgHom f V.1 W.1 hV) (s.1 V) := by
202	  have h := mapVal_spec C n f s W W le_rfl V hV
203	  rwa [Over.resAlgHom_rfl, DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id] at h
204	
205	/-- **Restriction of the widened vehicle along an arbitrary morphism of test objects** — the
206	last packaging layer of R2 residue (b): the value at each affine open of the source is the

11	/-!
12	# Presented étale covers of an affine base
13	
14	A (singleton, affine) *étale cover* of `Spec A` is a faithfully flat étale `A`-algebra `B`.
15	For the étale-sheafification (plus) construction of the relative Picard functor, the covers
16	of a fixed base must form a *small* directed index: this file realizes them as **presented**
17	covers — a number of variables `n` together with an ideal of `MvPolynomial (Fin n) A` whose
18	quotient is étale over `A` with `Spec` mapping onto `Spec A`.  The type of presented covers
19	of `A` lives in the same universe as `A`, while still capturing every étale cover up to
20	isomorphism of the carrier (`Algebra.EtaleCover.of` and its accessor `ofEquiv`).
21	
22	Surjectivity of the spectrum map is recorded instead of faithful flatness because it is
23	statable without flatness hypotheses; combined with flatness of étale algebras it *is*
24	faithful flatness (`Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_comap_surjective`), and that instance is
25	provided on the carrier.
26	
27	## Main declarations
28	
29	* `Algebra.EtaleCover A`: presented étale covers of `Spec A`, a `Type u` for `A : Type u`;
30	  `E.Carrier` is the covering algebra, with `Algebra.Etale A E.Carrier` and
31	  `Module.FaithfullyFlat A E.Carrier` instances.
32	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.of B hB`: any étale `A`-algebra `B` (with surjective spectrum map)
33	  underlies a presented cover, with carrier identification `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv`.
34	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.Refines`: `E'` refines `E` when the covering spectrum of `E'` maps
35	  to that of `E` over the base — a mere existence (`Prop`); the plus construction proves
36	  independence of the chosen refinement map, so no choice of map is carried here.
37	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.prod`: the common refinement `Spec (B ⊗[A] B')` of two covers, with
38	  refinement witnesses `prodInl`/`prodInr` — directedness of the index
39	  (`exists_refines_prod`).
40	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.self`: the trivial cover `Spec A` itself, refined by every cover
41	  (`refines_self`) — the base point of the index.
42	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.baseChange`: the pulled-back cover along `A → A'`, with carrier
43	  `A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (`baseChangeEquiv`) and the canonical `A`-algebra map
44	  `baseChangeInclude` into it.
45	* `Algebra.EtaleCover.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom`: over a field `K`, every cover
46	  is refined by a finite separable field extension of `K` (single-factor refinement) —
47	  field-extension covers are cofinal, the form the degree theory and Galois descent
48	  consume; `Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField` packages such an extension as a cover.
49	-/

107	    haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (MvPolynomial (Fin n) A ⧸ RingHom.ker f) :=
108	      .of_linearEquiv A B (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf).toLinearEquiv
109	    exact PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat

111	/-- The carrier of `ofSurjective` is the presented algebra. -/
112	noncomputable def ofSurjectiveEquiv
113	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B)))
114	    {n : ℕ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin n) A →ₐ[A] B) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
115	    (ofSurjective hB f hf).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] B :=
116	  Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hf
117	
118	/-- Any étale `A`-algebra whose spectrum covers `Spec A` underlies a presented étale
119	cover.  The presentation is chosen (étale algebras are finitely presented, in particular
120	finitely generated); the choice is harmless because consumers only ever use the carrier
121	identification `ofEquiv`. -/
122	noncomputable def of (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
123	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) : EtaleCover A :=
124	  ofSurjective hB
125	    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose
126	    (Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial''.mp inferInstance).choose_spec.choose_spec
127	
128	/-- The carrier of `of B hB` is `B` itself. -/
129	noncomputable def ofEquiv (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.Etale A B]
130	    (hB : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B))) :
131	    (of B hB).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] B :=
132	  ofSurjectiveEquiv hB _ _

136	/-! ## Refinement and directedness -/
137	
138	/-- `E'` refines `E`: the covering spectrum of `E'` maps to that of `E` over `Spec A`,
139	i.e. there is an `A`-algebra map from the carrier of `E` to that of `E'`.  This is a mere
140	existence: the plus construction proves that the induced maps on descent classes do not
141	depend on the chosen refinement map, so no map is carried here. -/
142	def Refines (E' E : EtaleCover A) : Prop :=
143	  Nonempty (E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E'.Carrier)
144	
145	theorem refines_refl (E : EtaleCover A) : E.Refines E :=
146	  ⟨AlgHom.id A E.Carrier⟩
147	
148	theorem Refines.trans {E E' E'' : EtaleCover A} (h : E''.Refines E') (h' : E'.Refines E) :
149	    E''.Refines E := by
150	  obtain ⟨f⟩ := h
151	  obtain ⟨g⟩ := h'
152	  exact ⟨f.comp g⟩
153	
154	/-- The common refinement of two covers: `Spec` of the tensor product of the carriers,
155	i.e. the fiber product of the covering spectra over the base. -/
156	noncomputable def prod (E E' : EtaleCover A) : EtaleCover A :=
157	  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
158	    Algebra.Etale.comp A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
159	  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
160	    Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
161	  .of (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
162	
163	/-- The carrier of the common refinement is the tensor product of the carriers. -/
164	noncomputable def prodEquiv (E E' : EtaleCover A) :
165	    (E.prod E').Carrier ≃ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier :=
166	  haveI : Algebra.Etale A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
167	    Algebra.Etale.comp A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
168	  haveI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) :=
169	    Module.FaithfullyFlat.trans A E.Carrier (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier)
170	  ofEquiv (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E'.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
171	
172	/-- The first refinement map of the common refinement. -/
173	noncomputable def prodInl (E E' : EtaleCover A) : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.prod E').Carrier :=
174	  ((E.prodEquiv E').symm.toAlgHom).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
175	
176	/-- The second refinement map of the common refinement. -/
177	noncomputable def prodInr (E E' : EtaleCover A) : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.prod E').Carrier :=
178	  ((E.prodEquiv E').symm.toAlgHom).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
179	
180	/-- Combine refinement maps out of the two factors into one out of the common
181	refinement (the universal property of the fiber product of the covering spectra). -/
182	noncomputable def prodLift {E E' F : EtaleCover A} (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
183	    (g : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) : (E.prod E').Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier :=
184	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _).comp
185	    (E.prodEquiv E').toAlgHom
186	
187	@[simp]
188	theorem prodLift_comp_prodInl {E E' F : EtaleCover A} (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
189	    (g : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) : (prodLift f g).comp (E.prodInl E') = f := by
190	  ext x
191	  simp [prodLift, prodInl]
192	
193	@[simp]
194	theorem prodLift_comp_prodInr {E E' F : EtaleCover A} (f : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier)
195	    (g : E'.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) : (prodLift f g).comp (E.prodInr E') = g := by
196	  ext x
197	  simp [prodLift, prodInr]
198	
199	theorem prod_refines_left (E E' : EtaleCover A) : (E.prod E').Refines E :=
200	  ⟨E.prodInl E'⟩
201	
202	theorem prod_refines_right (E E' : EtaleCover A) : (E.prod E').Refines E' :=
203	  ⟨E.prodInr E'⟩
204	
205	/-- Directedness of the refinement preorder: any two covers have a common refinement. -/
206	theorem exists_refines_prod (E E' : EtaleCover A) :
207	    ∃ E'' : EtaleCover A, E''.Refines E ∧ E''.Refines E' :=
208	  ⟨E.prod E', E.prod_refines_left E', E.prod_refines_right E'⟩
209	
210	/-- The trivial cover of `Spec A` by itself. -/
211	noncomputable def self (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : EtaleCover A :=
212	  .of A (by
213	    rw [show algebraMap A A = RingHom.id A from rfl, PrimeSpectrum.comap_id]
214	    exact fun p => ⟨p, rfl⟩)
215	
216	/-- The carrier of the trivial cover is the base ring. -/
217	noncomputable def selfEquiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] : (self A).Carrier ≃ₐ[A] A :=
218	  ofEquiv A _
219	
220	/-- The canonical refinement map from the trivial cover to any cover (algebra side: the
221	structure map of the carrier, through the trivial carrier's identification with `A`). -/
222	noncomputable def fromSelf (E : EtaleCover A) : (self A).Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier :=
223	  (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).comp (selfEquiv A).toAlgHom
224	
225	/-- Every cover refines the trivial cover: the trivial cover is the base point of the
226	refinement preorder. -/
227	theorem refines_self (E : EtaleCover A) : E.Refines (self A) :=
228	  ⟨E.fromSelf⟩

230	/-! ## Base change -/
231	
232	section baseChange
233	
234	variable (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A']
235	
236	/-- The base change of a cover along `A → A'`: the cover of `Spec A'` with carrier
237	`A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier` (the fiber product of the covering spectrum with the new base). -/
238	noncomputable def baseChange (E : EtaleCover A) : EtaleCover A' :=
239	  .of (A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
240	
241	/-- The carrier of the base-changed cover is the base-changed carrier. -/
242	noncomputable def baseChangeEquiv (E : EtaleCover A) :
243	    (E.baseChange A').Carrier ≃ₐ[A'] A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
244	  ofEquiv (A' ⊗[A] E.Carrier) PrimeSpectrum.comap_surjective_of_faithfullyFlat
245	
246	/-- The canonical map from the carrier of a cover to the carrier of its base change,
247	as a map of `A`-algebras. -/
248	noncomputable def baseChangeInclude (E : EtaleCover A) :
249	    E.Carrier →ₐ[A] (E.baseChange A').Carrier :=
250	  (((E.baseChangeEquiv A').symm.toAlgHom).restrictScalars A).comp
251	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
252	
253	/-- The base change of a refinement map: `A' ⊗[A] —` on carriers, through the
254	presented-carrier identifications — the functoriality of `baseChange` in the cover. -/
255	noncomputable def baseChangeMap {E F : EtaleCover A} (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
256	    (E.baseChange A').Carrier →ₐ[A'] (F.baseChange A').Carrier :=
257	  ((F.baseChangeEquiv A').symm.toAlgHom).comp
258	    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A' A') h).comp (E.baseChangeEquiv A').toAlgHom)
259	
260	/-- Base change of refinement maps commutes with the canonical inclusions into the base
261	change. -/
262	theorem baseChangeMap_comp_baseChangeInclude {E F : EtaleCover A}
263	    (h : E.Carrier →ₐ[A] F.Carrier) :
264	    ((baseChangeMap A' h).restrictScalars A).comp (E.baseChangeInclude A')
265	      = (F.baseChangeInclude A').comp h := by
266	  ext x
267	  simp [baseChangeMap, baseChangeInclude]
268	
269	end baseChange

271	/-! ## Covers of a field: single-factor refinement -/
272	
273	section field
274	
275	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
276	
277	/-- The carrier of a cover of a field (indeed, of any nontrivial base) is nontrivial. -/
278	theorem nontrivial_carrier (E : EtaleCover A) [Nontrivial A] : Nontrivial E.Carrier :=
279	  PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp
280	    ⟨(E.comap_surjective (Nonempty.some inferInstance)).choose⟩
281	
282	/-- **Field cofinality**: over a field, every presented étale cover is refined by a finite
283	separable field extension.  This single-factor refinement is what makes field-extension
284	covers cofinal among étale covers of `Spec K`: the étale carrier is a finite product of
285	finite separable extensions of `K`, and projection to any one factor still covers the
286	(one-point) spectrum of `K`. -/
287	theorem exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom (E : EtaleCover K) :
288	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
289	      (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L), Nonempty (E.Carrier →ₐ[K] L) := by
290	  haveI : Nontrivial E.Carrier := E.nontrivial_carrier
291	  obtain ⟨I, hI, Ai, hfield, halg, e, h⟩ :=
292	    (Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod K E.Carrier).mp inferInstance
293	  haveI : Nonempty I := by
294	    by_contra hempty
295	    haveI : IsEmpty I := not_nonempty_iff.mp hempty
296	    haveI : Subsingleton E.Carrier := e.toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr inferInstance
297	    exact false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton E.Carrier
298	  obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty I›
299	  exact ⟨Ai i, hfield i, halg i, (h i).1, (h i).2,
300	    ⟨(Pi.evalAlgHom K Ai i).comp e.toAlgHom⟩⟩
301	
302	variable (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
303	
304	instance : Algebra.Etale K L where
305	  formallyEtale := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable K L
306	  finitePresentation :=
307	    (Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType (R := K) (A := L)).mp inferInstance
308	
309	/-- A finite separable field extension as an étale cover of `Spec K` (the spectrum map
310	between the one-point spectra is trivially surjective). -/
311	noncomputable def ofField : EtaleCover K :=
312	  .of L fun _ => ⟨default, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
313	
314	/-- The carrier of the field cover is the field extension itself. -/
315	noncomputable def ofFieldEquiv : (ofField (K := K) L).Carrier ≃ₐ[K] L :=
316	  ofEquiv L _
317	
318	end field
319	
320	end EtaleCover

9	# The widened vehicle and divisor functor: carrying a widened class to a GENERAL test
10	
11	`divFamZarAff_of_forall_prime_certified_adaptation` (`…AffAssemble.lean`) is the endpoint of
12	the widened certificate lane, and what it returns is a class **at an affine test**
13	`DivFamZarAff C R n`.  Every DD-R consumer is stated against a *functor* on the whole slice
14	over `Spec k`, so between the lane's endpoint and its consumers sits the affine-opens limit —
15	the `divFamZar` vehicle of `DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean` — and that layer had no widened
16	counterpart.  This file supplies it, following the chart-typed template line for line.
17	
18	## The shape, and why it is unchanged by R2
19	
20	A section over a test `T` is a family of widened classes, one per affine open of `T.left`,
21	compatible under restriction.  R2 widened where the pieces live **on the curve**; it changed
22	nothing about the Zariski structure of the **base**.  So the vehicle's shape is literally the
23	old one with `DivFamZar` replaced by `DivFamZarAff` and `mapAlgHom` by the widened face of
24	`…AffFace.lean` — which is precisely why that face had to exist first.
25	
26	`[IsProper C.hom]` is carried throughout: the widened base change needs it (an arbitrary affine
27	open's overlaps are not affine by fiat), and it is a hypothesis the DD-R lane has everywhere.
28	
29	## What this file does NOT do, stated precisely
30	
31	It defines the widened vehicle and proves its affine collapse.  It does **not** define the
32	restriction `divFamZarAff.map` along an arbitrary morphism of test objects, and therefore does
33	not define the widened *functor* either.  That is the remaining item of the R2 lane
34	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 8 §8.3 item 2): its input is the widened form of the base-side
35	Zariski gluing keystone `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`
36	(`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarGlue.lean`), which should port because R2 left the base side alone —
37	but "should port" is a price, not a result, and nothing here assumes it.
38	
39	So a consumer can today be given a widened section over an **affine** test, and the general-test
40	statement is still owed.  Saying which is which is the point of this paragraph: a docstring that
41	advertises declarations a file does not contain is its own failure mode, and this tree has
42	already been bitten by it once.
43	
44	The comparison from the chart-typed side, `divFamZarToAffVehicle` below, does exist, and it goes
45	old → new only — the direction R2 asserts.  The converse is exactly what R2 says fails.
46	
47	## Main declarations
48	
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAff` — the widened affine-opens limit at an arbitrary test.
50	* `divFamZarAff.eval`, `divFamZarAff.compat`, `divFamZarAff.ext` — the section API.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffAffineEquiv` — on an affine test the limit collapses to
52	  `DivFamZarAff` of the test algebra.
53	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarToAffVehicle` — the comparison of vehicles, with
54	  `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_toAffVehicle` for its coherence with the two affine collapses.
55	-/

theorem map_injective_of_etaleCover {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

      obtain ⟨J, f, g, hfg⟩ := (mk_eq_mk_iff C).mp hxy
      letI : Algebra.Etale A J.Carrier :=

      letI : Module.FaithfullyFlat A J.Carrier :=

* **ζ3 (close)**: `M := cechPicEquivPic.symm (picClass v)` over `A`; establish `p_A^* M = L`

## Main declarations (this file)

* `AlgebraicGeometry.tensorInl`, `AlgebraicGeometry.tensorInr` — the two `k`-algebra
  coprojections `B →ₐ[k] B ⊗[A] B` (mirroring `doubleInl`/`doubleInr` of
  `Picard/PicEtAff.lean` for a general test algebra `B`), with the diagonal-coherence lemma
  `AlgebraicGeometry.tensorInl_comp_ofId`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.cechPicMap_tensorInl_eq_tensorInr` — sub-brick ζ1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
  [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]

/-- On a commutative `k`-algebra `B` which is also an `A`-algebra compatibly (a scalar tower
`k → A → B`), the `A`- and `k`-scalar actions commute. Needed so that
`Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft` elaborates as a `k`-algebra map into `B ⊗[A] B` and so
that `B ⊗[A] B` carries its `k`-algebra structure. -/
instance smulCommClass_of_isScalarTower : SMulCommClass A k B :=
  ⟨fun a c b => by simp only [Algebra.smul_def]; ring⟩

/-- The first coprojection `B →ₐ[k] B ⊗[A] B`, `b ↦ b ⊗ₜ 1`, as a `k`-algebra map — the
general-`B` mirror of `doubleInl` (`Picard/PicEtAff.lean`); definitionally
`Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft`. -/
def tensorInl : B →ₐ[k] B ⊗[A] B :=
  Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft

/-- The second coprojection `B →ₐ[k] B ⊗[A] B`, `b ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ b`, as a `k`-algebra map — the
general-`B` mirror of `doubleInr`; definitionally
`(Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight).restrictScalars k`. -/
def tensorInr : B →ₐ[k] B ⊗[A] B :=
  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight).restrictScalars k

/-- **Diagonal coherence of the two coprojections.** Precomposed with the base inclusion
`A →ₐ[k] B`, the two coprojections `B → B ⊗[A] B` agree: both send `a` to the image of
`algebraMap A B a`, and over `A` we have `(algebraMap A B a) ⊗ₜ 1 = 1 ⊗ₜ (algebraMap A B a)`.
This is what collapses the two base changes of a class pulled back from the base. -/
lemma tensorInl_comp_ofId :
    (tensorInl (A := A) (B := B)).comp ((Algebra.ofId A B).restrictScalars k)
      = (tensorInr (A := A) (B := B)).comp ((Algebra.ofId A B).restrictScalars k) := by
  ext a
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply, Algebra.ofId_apply, tensorInl,
    tensorInr, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, TensorProduct.smul_tmul]

assembly; the projection step of Kleiman, *The Picard Scheme*, Theorem 2.5(1)). If a Čech

`tensorInl_comp_ofId`), so they agree by injectivity of curve-projection pullback (brick 3,

/-!
# Faithfully-flat descent for the widened divisor functor, via representability

The widened divisor functor `divFunctorAff C (genus C)` is representable
(`divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy`, `Picard/DivRepAffChallenge.lean`), and over an affine
test the functor value collapses to `DivFamZarAff` (`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv`,
`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffVehicle.lean`).  Composing the two turns a widened class over a test
algebra into a **classifying morphism** to the representing scheme, naturally in the algebra
(`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality`, `Picard/DivisorFamilyAffMap.lean`).

This file cashes that in for descent: `Spec` of a faithfully flat ring map is quasi-compact,
surjective and flat, hence an **effective epimorphism** of schemes by the fpqc-subcanonicity
instance (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Fpqc.lean`).  Precomposition with an (effective) epi
is injective, so the widened divisor presheaf is *separated* along faithfully flat maps; and a
class over the carrier of an étale cover whose two coprojection pullbacks to the tensor square
agree has classifying morphism coequalizing the kernel pair of the cover (through
`pullbackSpecIso`), so it *descends*, uniquely, to the base ring.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.classify` — the classifying equivalence
  `DivFamZarAff C S (genus C) ≃ (overSpec k S ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C)`, with naturality
  `DivFamZarAff.classify_mapAlgHom`.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat` — `Spec` of a faithfully flat
  algebra map is an effective epimorphism.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat` — the
  separated-presheaf property of the widened carrier along faithfully flat maps.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq` — effective-epi descent of a

noncomputable def DivFamZarAff.classify (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :

classifying morphism of the base change is `Spec` of the map followed by the classifying
morphism.  `divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_naturality` composed with the representability coherence
`Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm`. -/

  infer_instance

/-- **The separated-presheaf property of the widened carrier**: base change of widened locally
certified divisor classes along a faithfully flat map of test algebras is injective.  Through
`classify`, base change is precomposition of the classifying morphism with `Spec` of the map,
which is an (effective) epimorphism. -/
theorem DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat {S S' : Type u} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k S] [CommRing S'] [Algebra k S'] [Algebra S S'] [IsScalarTower k S S']
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat S S'] :
    Function.Injective
      (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (C := C) (n := genus C) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S')) := by
  intro F G hFG
  haveI : EffectiveEpi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S'))) :=
    effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat
  haveI : Epi ((Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S')).left) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S S'))))
  haveI : Epi (Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S')) :=
    Over.epi_of_epi_left _
  have hc := congrArg (classify S') hFG
  rw [classify_mapAlgHom, classify_mapAlgHom] at hc
  exact (classify S).injective
    ((cancel_epi (Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k S S'))).mp hc)

/-- **Effective-epi descent of a widened divisor class along an étale cover**: a widened
locally certified divisor class over the carrier of an étale cover of `Spec A` whose two
coprojection pullbacks to the tensor square of the carrier agree descends, uniquely, to a class
over `A`.

The classifying morphism of `F` coequalizes the kernel pair of the covering morphism
`Spec E.Carrier ⟶ Spec A` (the kernel pair is `Spec` of the tensor square, by
`pullbackSpecIso`), so it factors through the effective epi; the factorization lands back in
the slice over `Spec k` by epi cancellation, and uniqueness is the separated-presheaf
property. -/
theorem DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (F : DivFamZarAff C E.Carrier (genus C))
    (h : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
            E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) F
        = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
            E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) F) :
    ∃! F₀ : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) F₀ = F := by
  classical
  haveI : EffectiveEpi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))) :=
    effectiveEpi_specMap_of_faithfullyFlat
  -- the double-pullback agreement of classifying morphisms, in the slice over `Spec k`
  have hOv : Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
        ≫ classify E.Carrier F
      = Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
        ≫ classify E.Carrier F := by
    rw [← classify_mapAlgHom, ← classify_mapAlgHom, h]
  -- hence the classifying morphism coequalizes the kernel pair of the covering morphism
  have hfstsnd : pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
        ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left
      = pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
        ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (pullbackSpecIso A E.Carrier E.Carrier).inv,
      pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst_assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd_assoc]
    exact congrArg CommaMorphism.left hOv
  have hcoeq : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g₁ g₂ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)),
      g₁ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
        = g₂ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
      → g₁ ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left = g₂ ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left := by
    intro Z g₁ g₂ hg
    calc g₁ ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left
        = pullback.lift g₁ g₂ hg ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
      _ = pullback.lift g₁ g₂ hg ≫ pullback.snd _ _ ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left := by
          rw [hfstsnd]
      _ = g₂ ≫ (classify E.Carrier F).left := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd]
  -- descend the classifying morphism at the scheme level
  set w : Spec (.of A) ⟶ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left :=
    EffectiveEpi.desc (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
      (classify E.Carrier F).left hcoeq with hw
  have hfac : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)) ≫ w
      = (classify E.Carrier F).left := by
    rw [hw]; exact EffectiveEpi.fac _ _ _
  -- the over-triangle of the descended morphism, by epi cancellation
  have htri : w ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom = (overSpec k A).hom := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))),
      ← Category.assoc, hfac, Over.w]
    show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k E.Carrier))
        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
          ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k A E.Carrier, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp]
  -- the descended class, through the slice-level factorization
  have hex : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
      ((classify A).symm (Over.homMk w htri)) = F := by
    apply (classify E.Carrier).injective
    rw [classify_mapAlgHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext hfac
  refine ⟨(classify A).symm (Over.homMk w htri), hex, fun F₀ hF₀ => ?_⟩
  have hcan : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A E.Carrier
      = (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k := AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
  apply DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_injective_of_faithfullyFlat (S := A) (S' := E.Carrier)
  rw [hcan, hF₀, hex]
